I have verified the relevant source. Here are my findings.

FINDINGS: [{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#tokenize","claim":"tokenize lowercases, splits on non-alphanumeric/underscore, keeps tokens longer than 2 chars, and drops a STOP set of common words","evidence":"src/db.mjs:224"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#idfRank","claim":"idfRank scores each entry as the sum of IDF weights of query tokens present in the entry, filters score>0, sorts descending, and slices to limit","evidence":"src/db.mjs:229-238"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#idfRank","claim":"idfRank computes IDF as log(1 + N/df) where N is entry count and df is document frequency of the token","evidence":"src/db.mjs:232"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"getLessons ranks non-pass attempts across all plans by IDF-weighted lexical match of terms (or step title+tools), excluding the step's own attempts and scoping to the current project unless all=true","evidence":"src/db.mjs:763-780"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#getLessons","claim":"getLessons tie-breaks equal scores by created_at descending (newest first) and returns score rounded to 2 decimals","evidence":"src/db.mjs:780-785"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall builds candidate docs from plans, steps, attempts, and active findings, scoped to the current project unless all=true, and ranks them with the shared idfRank","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1071-1095"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#recall","claim":"recall only includes findings with status 'active', and surfaces a finding with non-empty conflicts_with as status 'conflict'","evidence":"src/db.mjs:1087-1090"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"src/db.mjs#currentProjectId","claim":"currentProjectId reads the settings key 'current_project' and defaults to project id 1 when unset","evidence":"src/db.mjs:417-420"}]

VERDICT: pass — verified Store.recall and Store.getLessons both use the shared IDF-weighted lexical ranker (idfRank + tokenize), with getLessons ranking non-pass attempts scoped to the current project and recall ranking plans/steps/attempts/active findings.
